# lowkey.tools

> lowkey.tools is a small collection of free, single purpose web tools from the
> makers of OwlEye Analytics. Each tool does one job in the browser. There is no
> account, no onboarding and nothing to install.

Every tool lives on the same domain under its own path. The tools are independent
apps, deployed separately and proxied onto lowkey.tools by path prefix.

## Tools

- [Superbrain](https://lowkey.tools/superbrain): A place to dump notes, links and half formed ideas, and actually find them again later.
- [Supersplit](https://lowkey.tools/supersplit): Split expenses with a group, track who paid for what, and see who owes whom.
- [Favigen](https://lowkey.tools/favigen): Drop in one image and get back every favicon and app icon size a site needs.

## Coming soon

- Credo: not live yet, it will appear at https://lowkey.tools/credo

## Facts

- Cost: every tool listed here is free to use.
- Account: none required.
- Platform: runs in any modern web browser, no install step.
- Maker: OwlEye Analytics, built by Shrinath Prabhu.

## About the makers

- [OwlEye Analytics](https://owleye.dev): the product team behind lowkey.tools.
- [Shrinath Prabhu](https://shrinath.me): developer.
